# Moriyati ERP factory review, v0.3

Source: https://github.com/moriyati-ir/moriyati.ir/tree/moriyati-erp/erp

Build: from the ERP checkout, install the locked dependencies, run `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, and `node scripts/build-github-preview.mjs`. The generated `work/github-preview/dist` is published at `dist/erp` of the main website repository.

All numbers and work statuses are samples. Names/roles are an organisational model, not staff login credentials. Pages saves only to this browser. Its v3 storage key upgrades v2 records without deleting v2 or v1 data. Real employee authentication, five-minute administrator-issued login codes, hardware readers, accounting settlement and customer-facing cryptographic authenticity are not claimed as active.
